title: millettia oraria
intro: Millettia oraria, commonly known as the Indian milk bush, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Millettia oraria include its ability to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, with its bioactive constituents contributing to its medicinal effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
